checks.transport_mem_gxGroupoid: Statement: for an open embedding ι : X' → X ([Nonempty X'], needed by IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph), a hom φ : G' →* G with ι (g • p) = φ g • ι p, and f ∈ gxGroupoid G' X', the transported (ι⁻¹ ≫ f) ≫ ι lies in gxGroupoid G X. Mathematically right: near x ∈ ι(X'), f = g • · near ι⁻¹ x gives ι ∘ f ∘ ι⁻¹ = φ g • · near x, and the symm half is the same argument for f.symm after trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm. It is the form needed: the transition maps of a charted space over X' composed with ι are ι⁻¹ ≫ (e.symm ≫ e') ≫ ι. Non-vacuous: instantiated in a scratch file with ι = id, φ = MonoidHom.id G (typechecks). No injectivity of φ assumed, none needed. Docstring matches the statement
